0022600193.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6) visit the Golden State Warriors (6-3) for the Magic's ninth game of the season. Orlando is 5th in the Southeast and 12th in the East, 2.5 games back, on a three-game losing streak and 0-4 at home, while Golden State is on a six-game winning streak, 4-1 at home, and 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 7th in the West. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), with Gui Santos listed as day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. The teams have not played each other yet this season, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the most recent meeting on December 22, 2025 in San Francisco, where the Magic lost 120-97.
